goals: Move into a staff-level data platform role.

roles.title: Staff Engineer
roles.summary: Owned the billing and reporting stack.

accomplishments.situation: Month-end close took nine days and blocked the finance team.
accomplishments.action: Rewrote the billing pipeline as incremental Airflow jobs.
accomplishments.result: Close dropped from nine days to two.
accomplishments.source_text: I rewrote the billing pipeline at Acme as incremental Airflow jobs and cut month-end close from nine days to two. I did the design and most of the build.

accomplishments.situation: Nightly pipeline failures were paging on-call roughly five times a week.
accomplishments.action: Added retry, backfill and alerting logic across ~20 nightly jobs.
accomplishments.result: On-call pages fell from about five a week to under one.
accomplishments.source_text: We were paging someone every week for pipeline failures. I added retry and alerting logic across the twenty or so nightly jobs and on-call pages dropped from about five a week to under one.

accomplishments.situation: New data-team hires took about a month to become productive.
accomplishments.action: Mentored two junior engineers and wrote the team onboarding guide.
accomplishments.result: New hires reached productivity in about a week.
accomplishments.source_text: I mentored two junior engineers through their first year on the data team, and I wrote the onboarding guide the team still uses to get new hires productive in about a week instead of a month.

evidence.source_text: I rewrote the billing pipeline at Acme as incremental Airflow jobs and cut month-end close from nine days to two. I did the design and most of the build.
I've been writing Python daily for about eight years, mostly data work, and I'd call myself strong with Airflow after four years of running it in production.
We were paging someone every week for pipeline failures. I added retry and alerting logic across the twenty or so nightly jobs and on-call pages dropped from about five a week to under one.
I mentored two junior engineers through their first year on the data team, and I wrote the onboarding guide the team still uses to get new hires productive in about a week instead of a month.
